title: [NEXT-1146] Hashes are different between multiple servers with generateBuildId

labels.name: bug

labels.name: linear: next

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: arm64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.4.0: Mon Mar  6 21:00:41 PST 2023; root:xnu-8796.101.5~3/RELEASE_ARM64_T8103
    Binaries:
      Node: 16.13.0
      npm: 8.1.0
      Yarn: 1.22.11
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.0
      eslint-config-next: 13.4.0
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/mcAnastasiou/nextjs-build-id

### To Reproduce

Try to build multiple times using a unique generateBuildId

### Describe the Bug

The webpack chunk hash and/or main chunk hash are different between different builds with the same generateBuildId

![Screenshot 2023-05-04 at 20 44 57](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45881723/236286848-12b0c86c-09f0-4c81-894b-e225abe5dabd.png)


### Expected Behavior

The webpack chunk hash should be the same when a build is using the same generateBuildId
